item.title: Hoshi to Otome ga Uranau Mirai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: iMel Inc., Rosetta
  • 発売日: 2022-12-22
  • スコア: 5.17/10 (36 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 星と乙女が占う未来
  • 英語名: Hoshi to Otome ga Uranau Mirai

あらすじ

-Even small things, like “making someone happy”, or “being able to support someone”, are what makes being an astrologer worthwhile.

The Astrologer “Izumi Mizushiro”, who lives with her younger sister, “Towa”, divines her clients in a corner of the coffee shop “Rino” runs.

The clients Izumi divines leave their seat with a smile and seeing them smile makes Izumi feel happy and rewarded.

item.title: Sentou Kanojo -Koi mo Ofuro mo Atsuatsu de-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: iMel Inc., Rosetta
  • 発売日: 2022-07-28
  • スコア: 6.11/10 (97 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 銭湯カノジョ-恋もお風呂もアツアツで-
  • 英語名: Sentou Kanojo -Koi mo Ofuro mo Atsuatsu de-

别名

  • Sentou Kanojo -Koi mo Ofuro mo Atsuatsu de-

あらすじ

“Why do I have to dress up as a woman!?”

Asahi Kirisaki, who was just taking it easy during his summer vacation, finds out that his grandmother has been hospitalized. And his grandma’s hospitalization put the Japanese bathhouse (Sento) she ran in danger of having to close permanently.
